spans.text: The time is 22:30, in the enemies' outpost in the sewers...
Didn't think I'd have to come save your butts so soon...
Figured I could slack off for several minutes since it's you folks...
Sorry for making you work overtime, but the mission isn't over yet.
We've already tracked down the last-known location of our target's signal, so please make for the coordinates I just indicated before regrouping with us.
Are you sure you want me to go there? My order is to get you out.
The Commander has approved of my proposal.
Sorry, the next part of the mission is going to be highly dangerous, so it'd be great if you can coordinate with the HOC and have them within range.
Sure... I just saw the approval notification. The Commander sure does trust you.
I hope you can trust me, too.
What else can I do? I'm here anyway. I'd rather tidy up after you instead of SAW.
So what do we do next?
As our escape route has been altered, we'll have to re-enter the sewers halfway through the secret passage.
We're bound to run into the white enemies, but we must try our best to avoid an extended fight. The snappier we move the better.
Roger that. My team will do what we can to suppress the enemies and stop them from pinning you down.
After that, once we enter the sections with the floodgates, I'll try to hack their control panels and lock the enemies out on the other side.
However, I have to remain stationary while controlling the gates so please watch my back.
Huh? You're gonna engage in electronic warfare in the middle of the operation?
If you screw up the controls and lock us and the HOC out with the white enemies, we'll be finished!
Trust me. I've studied the structure at length. I can do it.
